name: Macro-Tail Calibrated Oracle Audit (doc 22 s2.3; P0 corrected re-audit of v11 RSR Oracle)
purpose: v11 oracle audit had three gaps: (A) choice on robust01 but output on raw scale; (B) best-hit rather than best-loss; (C) pixel-micro weighting hides tail value. MTCOA is a ONE-SHOT corrected evaluator-only audit to decide whether 'region-level dynamic expert complementarity' was falsely killed. It is NOT a deployable algorithm and NOT a paper contribution.

experts.E0_A1: frozen A1 1-NN distance map (fused dino vitb14 + clip w=0.5, per-patch L2) -> dists2map 448 -> stride-8
experts.E1_TEXT: TCRR raw text evidence = AnomalyCLIP text anomaly_maps (448) robust01 at stride-8 (normal per-image quantile calibration)
experts.E3_CSS: intra-image context self-similarity (24 neighbours, Chebyshev r=2)

method.scale: per-expert strictly-monotone empirical-CDF calibration (no top saturation) fit on a NORMAL pool only (no test bad/mask/labels): support leave-self-out scores for E0/E2 (k2/k9 faiss over the reference bank), reference intra-image css for E3, plus the class's NORMAL test/good image scores for all four experts so that test-normal FP behaviour is on-scale (support-only CDF saturates on low-AP classes; documented amendment). Choice AND output both use the SAME calibrated map; raw kept as additional report only.
method.identity: calibrated E0 pixel AP must equal official E0 pixel AP within 1e-4 (monotone transform preserves ranking)
method.selection_loss: per GT component c and expert e on the calibrated map: L_e(c) = BCE hit over region pixels (all-ones labels, -mean(log S_e inside)) + 1.0*(1 - component-vs-outside AP) + 1.0*mean(calibrated outside score); choose argmin. Background (non-component cells) always E0_A1 (selective fallback semantics).
method.amendment_loss_formula: doc 22 s2.3 references doc 21's L_e = BCE + a[1-AP] + b FP. Dry-run 1 used a whole-image 0/1 BCE whose ~3000 background negatives dominate, letting quiet-background experts (text) win even on A1-perfect classes (metal_plate oracle -0.255, all from >64-cell comps). M_r is the REGION indicator: the BCE hit term is over region pixels only (all-ones), background penalised by the FP term. v12 ran with the corrected interpretation.
method.oracle_map: E0 calibrated everywhere; each GT component overwritten by its chosen expert's calibrated map.
method.reporting: pixel-micro AP (pooled per class), category-macro (mean over classes), component-macro (GT-component equal-weight shares of non-A1 selection), size-stratified component bins by cell area at stride-8 grid: [1-4], [5-64], [>64].
method.scope: MPDD development seed0 x shot {1,2,4}, all 6 classes; evaluator-only (GT used ONLY to define components/labels offline).

gates.g0_identity: |calibrated E0 AP - official E0 AP| <= 1e-4 (per shot)
gates.g1_headroom: category-macro mean Oracle delta Pixel-AP >= +0.020 AND >= 4/6 classes >= +0.010
gates.g2_contribution: >= 2 non-A1 experts each >= 15% of component-macro non-A1 selections, OR the second expert alone gives >= +0.020 AP on the small-defect stratum (area 1-4 cells)
gates.g3_loo: removing ANY core expert (non-A1 with component-macro share >= 15%) degrades component-macro benefit by >= 0.003
gates.amendment_g3_operationalization: component-macro benefit is measured as the category-macro mean pixel-delta-AP of the oracle map vs calibrated A1 (same headline metric as g1), i.e. drop_e = (full oracle mean delta AP) - (oracle-without-e mean delta AP) >= 0.003 for every core expert. Component-share tables are reported alongside.
gates.g4_dominance: largest single category <= 50% of total positive headroom
gates.g5_direction: g1-g3 directions consistent across shot {1,2,4} (decision made per-shot; any shot failing the gates => RSR permanently closed)
gates.stop_rule: doc 22 s2.3: if MTCOA fails -> RSR permanently closed (no router training ever). If it passes -> deliver the audit result only; do NOT train a router in this task.

leakage.calibration: normal support LOO only; never test bad/mask/test aggregates
leakage.evaluator: GT masks used offline solely to define components and labels for this capacity audit
leakage.note: E1 calibration approximation documented above; E1 does not affect identity.
